preconditions.description: The length of the serial number n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The total number of changes and checks m + k must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for l, r in changes) and all(0 <= c <= 9 for c in changes)
preconditions.description: For each change, the indices l and r must be valid within the serial number, and c must be a digit from 0 to 9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n and 1 <= d <= r - l + 1 for l, r, d in checks)
preconditions.description: For each check, the indices l and r must be valid within the serial number, and d must be a valid period length.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(s[i] == s[i + d] for i in range(l - 1, r - d)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: For each check, output 'YES' if the substring from l to r has period d, otherwise output 'NO'.
